summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found from auditing the flow (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full path end to end:  - **`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`** — loads watchlists via `api.get("/watchlist")` on mount, loads the active list's detail via `api.get("/watchlist/:id")`, and add/remove card actions correctly call `api.post`/`api.delete` against the real endpoints. No localStorage or anonymous/local fallback anywhere. - **`client/src/lib/api.ts`** — every request sends `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie is always attached.
